summary: Updated README.md with Quick Start section (createMenu() usage example with minimal config and exit code handling), createMenu() function API section (dispatch order table, construction-time validation, exit code contract, code example), and Launcher scripts section (menu.sh bash snippet and menu.cmd batch snippet).

Removed stale Phase A/Phase B framing throughout README.md: dropped the Phase B sub-path exports planned note, removed the Phase A coverage exclusion note for raw-mode/screen modules, replaced the clearScreen() Phase B hardening note with the accurate implemented behaviour (non-TTY no-op), and removed the waitForKey() Phase B hardening note (waitForKey() now delegates to enterRawMode() as planned).

Fixed the stale barrel comment in src/index.ts: replaced 'Phase A barrel export' framing (with reference to Phase B deferral) with a plain 'complete barrel export' comment, per the reviewer documentation-forward item.

comments.note: README.md now contains both the Quick Start section (before Sub-path exports) and the createMenu() API section (after Help rendering). The dispatch order is documented as a table matching the implementation in src/create-menu.ts exactly.

The reviewer documentation-forward item (index.ts barrel comment referencing Phase A/B framing) was addressed: the comment is now 'Public API — complete barrel export. Re-exports all library modules.' — version-neutral and accurate.
